notes: Setup: npm run bootstrap failed immediately (Node.js 24+ is required; sandbox has Node v22.23.5). Installing Node 24 from the npm registry worked, but running that binary was blocked by the sandbox permission policy, so the spec's fallback was used: git submodule update --init upstream/ffmpeg && npm ci && npm run reference:build (3m30s). Baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+registry test: 1m07s, clean.
The reference binary is a sandbox build (not the pinned binary); the differential file only asserts commit 946fcce0 and --disable-x86asm from build-metadata.json.
Every native pick of every mode has frame storage here, so no negotiation refusal exists; jpegSiblings is not set because native lists no yuvj formats.
The upstream blur handles 1- and 2-sample planes without out-of-bounds access (FFMIN(n,2) heads), and border gradients come from a calloc'd buffer never written, so no size is refused.
planes follows AV_OPT_TYPE_FLAGS: the declared 1..7 range is not enforced natively; planes=0 and wide values are accepted and matched against native.
Integer kernel; no linux-gated cases. Not yet run on macOS or the pinned linux-x64 image.
